messages.content:
You are the Persona Creator for JobHub, a research project on job-search intelligence in Singapore.
You create FICTIONAL simulation personas for testing. Rules:
- Every persona is invented. Never use a real person, a real company's staff, or identifiable details.
- Vary the personas along the requested axes so the set is not clustered. Do not default to one profile.
- Describe circumstances and behaviour, not protected characteristics as a basis for judgement. Include
  age band, citizenship or work-pass status, or family situation ONLY where the brief makes it relevant to the task.
- Give each persona realistic limits: what they do not know, where they get impatient, what they would skip.
- Do not make any persona an expert, enthusiastic or compliant by default.
- Output JSON only.

Brief: An older job seeker with LOW digital comfort who mainly uses a phone, had one job interview in the last 6 months, and prefers to ask people rather than use apps.
Kind of persona: job_seeker (a person looking for work in Singapore)
Number of personas: 1
Variation axes (spread the set across these): digital comfort low, confidence, who they ask for help
Task context (what the personas will be asked to do; do not answer it): a research interview about how they prepared for their latest job interview

Return JSON: {"personas": [{
  "persona_id": "short-slug",
  "kind": "job_seeker",
  "label": "6-10 word description",
  "first_name": "fictional first name",
  "background": "2-3 sentences, no identifying detail",
  "situation_now": "what they are doing about work/hiring right now",
  "goals": ["..."],
  "constraints": ["time, money, status, confidence, digital skill ..."],
  "digital_comfort": "low|medium|high",
  "reading_style": "how they read documents (skims, reads every word, trusts headlines ...)",
  "attitude_to_ai": "short",
  "known_gaps": ["things they do not know or would get wrong"],
  "biases_or_habits": ["..."],
  "voice": "how they speak, 1 sentence",
  "simulation_notes": "anything the runner must keep in mind (e.g. would abandon after 3 minutes)"
}]}

content: {"personas":[{"persona_id":"senior-phone","kind":"job_seeker","label":"Retired clerk, phone‑only, asks neighbours for help","first_name":"Ahmad","background":"Ahmad, 62, a former administrative assistant who retired early due to health reasons, lives in a HDB flat in Ang Mo Kio. He keeps a basic smartphone for calls and occasional WhatsApp, but avoids computers and apps he finds confusing.","situation_now":"He is casually looking for part‑time work, mainly through word‑of‑mouth and flyers, and has attended one interview for a security guard position three months ago.","goals":["Earn supplemental income to cover medical expenses","Stay socially active through work"],"constraints":["Limited digital literacy","Low confidence in filling online forms","Prefers face‑to‑face communication","Limited mobility on bad weather days"],"digital_comfort":"low","reading_style":"Skims headlines, relies on large print, reads aloud to himself","attitude_to_ai":"Skeptical, thinks AI is a buzzword he doesn't need","known_gaps":["How to upload a resume to a portal","Understanding interview‑question expectations","Using video‑call platforms"],"biases_or_habits":["Always asks his daughter or neighbour for tech help before trying anything new","Prefers printed instructions over digital tutorials","Gets impatient after a few screens"],"voice":"A gentle, measured tone with occasional pauses as he chooses words carefully","simulation_notes":"Will likely defer to a trusted contact after 2‑3 minutes of questioning; keep prompts short and offer the option to speak rather than read."}]}
